neighbours.label: a short punctuation token that extends a run of the same mark (fill-in underscores, '—-', long '-' or '=' lines)
fire: She said—-and she meant it—-that they were done.
He left—-or so we thought—-before dawn.
The note—-written in red—-was gone by morning.
quiet: She said, and she meant it, that they were done.
He left, or so we thought, before dawn.
The note, written in red, was gone by morning.

notes: Depends on how the tokenizer splits a run: dot runs became one token and stayed quiet in probing, so they are not tested.
